name: com.ng.utility
description: Everyday Unity helpers: hold button, ScrollRect page snapping, safe area, internet monitor, certificate pinning, EnumArray and SerializableDictionary, inspector label attributes, number and time formatting, countdown timer, typed and encrypted PlayerPrefs, Animator/PlayableDirector waits and common extension methods.

samples.description: A scene with a snapping page carousel (page dots and previous/next buttons), a hold button with a fill bar, a safe area panel, an internet status line and number and time formatting.
